cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial menu screen renders with all options and the action footer
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Sign on as an authorized admin operator.
2. From the Main Menu select Admin Batch Operations (start transaction OROP).
3. Observe the initial screen.
cases.expected: The Admin Batch Operations screen appears with the heading 「ADMIN BATCH OPERATIONS」 and the eight numbered options 「1. Post Daily Transactions」, 「2. Post Bill Payment」, 「3. Assess Interest」, 「4. Assess Fees」, 「5. Charge-Off Delinquent」, 「6. Close Expired/Flagged」, 「7. Renew / Reissue Cards」, 「8. Cycle / EOM Roll」. The 「Option (1-8):」 and 「Param:」 entry boxes are shown empty (green), the message line shows 「Select an operation (1-8) and press ENTER.」, and the footer shows 「ENTER=Run  PF3=Exit  PF4=Clear」.
cases.remark: OCOPS 1000-SEND-INITIAL (SEND MAP MOPSA/MOPS ERASE); covers message M1 (ERRMSGO L99). Footer literal L145. UI §2.1.

cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Header band shows transaction, program, system title and current date/time
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Batch Operations screen.
2. Read the top two header lines.
cases.expected: The header shows 「Tran:」 = 「OROP」, 「Pgm :」 = 「OCOPS」, the system title 「ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM」, 「Date:」 with the current date (e.g. 「2026-09-28」) and 「Time:」 with the current time (e.g. 「14:30:05」).
cases.remark: 8000-POPULATE-HEADER + 8500-GET-DATE-TIME (ASKTIME/FORMATTIME, DATESEP '-', TIMESEP ':'). WHEAD WS-HDR-TITLE. UI §2.1 rows 1-9.

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the entry fields are empty and the cursor rests on Option
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Batch Operations screen.
2. Without typing, check the entry fields and cursor position.
cases.expected: 「Option (1-8):」 and 「Param:」 are both empty and the cursor (initial focus) is positioned on the 「Option (1-8):」 field, ready for a 1-2 digit entry.
cases.remark: BMS OPTION = UNPROT/IC/FSET (initial cursor). WS-OPTION value ZEROS. UI §2.1 item-states 'Initial display' OPTION/PARM ○.

cases.mid: 表示条件・活性制御 (Display conditions / enable control)
cases.name: Result area is output-only and blank until an operation has run
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Open the Admin Batch Operations screen.
2. Try to type into the result labels area (Read / Selected / Posted / Updated / Rejected / Trans / Amt1 / Amt2 and the status line).
cases.expected: The result fields 「Read:」, 「Selected:」, 「Posted:」, 「Updated:」, 「Rejected:」, 「Trans:」, 「Amt1:」, 「Amt2:」, the status field and the result message are display-only (the cursor cannot enter them) and are blank; they populate only after an operation has been run.
cases.remark: BMS result fields ASKIP/NORM; UI §2.1 item-states result fields □ all modes. Populated by 7500-SHOW-RESULT only.

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Counts are shown zero-suppressed with separators; amounts signed with 2 decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD; run an operation whose result returns a large read count (e.g. 1,234,567), a zero updated count, and a negative amount (e.g. -12,345.67).
cases.steps:
1. Run any operation (e.g. Option 「1」) that returns those counts.
2. Read the result count and amount fields.
cases.expected: The read count shows as 「1,234,567」 (leading zeros suppressed, thousands separators), the zero updated count shows as 「0」, and the amount shows signed with two decimals 「-12,345.67」. Note: the amount field holds at most 9 integer digits, so a returned amount of 10+ integer digits is truncated at the high-order end on display.
cases.remark: WS-D-CNT PIC ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9; WS-D-AMT PIC -,---,---,--9.99 (9 int digits) vs KO-AMT-1 S9(13)V99. 7500-SHOW-RESULT L297-312.

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Non-numeric option is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. In 「Option (1-8):」 type 「A」.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No operation runs; the screen stays on Admin Batch Operations and the message line shows 「Invalid option. Enter 1 through 8.」.
cases.remark: 2100-RUN-OPERATION: IF OPTIONI NUMERIC fails → WS-OPTION=0 → 7000 EVALUATE OTHER → WS-SUB-PGM SPACES → M2 (ERRMSGO L154) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY. UI §3 row 2.

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank option (ENTER with nothing selected) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Leave 「Option (1-8):」 empty.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No operation runs; the message line shows 「Invalid option. Enter 1 through 8.」 and the operator is asked to select 1-8.
cases.remark: Blank fails IF OPTIONI NUMERIC → WS-OPTION=0 → EVALUATE OTHER → SPACES → M2 L154. Distinct trigger (required/blank) vs non-numeric UT_OPS_ABNORMAL_001.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF3 exits to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Admin Batch Operations screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF3.
cases.expected: The current action is cancelled and control returns to the Main Menu (OCMENU).
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU → XCTL PROGRAM(WS-MENU-PGM=OCMENU). Footer 「PF3=Exit」. UI §4 row 2.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF12 also exits to the Main Menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Admin Batch Operations screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF12.
cases.expected: The current action is cancelled and control returns to the Main Menu (OCMENU) — same as PF3 (PF12 is active in the source though it is not shown on the footer).
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF12 → 7000-XCTL-MENU. UI §4 row 4. Not on footer literal.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entries and redisplays the menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the operator has typed Option 「3」 and some Param text.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF4.
cases.expected: The entered values are discarded and the initial menu is redisplayed with 「Option (1-8):」 and 「Param:」 empty and the message line 「Select an operation (1-8) and press ENTER.」.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (LOW-VALUES to MOPSAO, ERASE). Footer 「PF4=Clear」. UI §1.2 keys.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: CLEAR redisplays the cleared menu
cases.precondition: F-STD; the operator has typed into the screen.
cases.steps: 1. Press CLEAR.
cases.expected: The screen is cleared and redisplayed as the initial menu (same result as PF4), with empty entry fields and 「Select an operation (1-8) and press ENTER.」.
cases.remark: 2000 WHEN DFHCLEAR → 1000-SEND-INITIAL. UI §4 row 5.

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: Unsupported key is rejected with a retry message
cases.precondition: F-STD; the Admin Batch Operations screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press an unsupported key, e.g. PF1.
cases.data: AID = PF1 (any key other than ENTER/PF3/PF12/PF4/CLEAR).
cases.expected: No operation runs and no navigation happens; the screen stays and the message line shows 「Invalid key pressed. Please try again.」.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN OTHER → MOVE WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY to ERRMSGO (M5, WMSG constant) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY. UI §3 row 5.

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Pseudo-conversational re-entry: first entry shows the menu, next ENTER is processed
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction OROP fresh (no prior communication area) — the menu appears.
2. Type Option 「1」 and press ENTER.
cases.expected: On the first entry the initial menu is displayed (nothing is processed). The transaction ends returning to itself, so the next ENTER is treated as input and Option 「1」 is processed (Post Daily Transactions runs).
cases.remark: 0000-MAIN: EIBCALEN=0 or CA-FIRST-ENTER → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (sets CA-PGM-CONTEXT=1); else 2000-PROCESS-INPUT. RETURN TRANSID('OROP'). KCOMM CA-FIRST-ENTER=0 / CA-RE-ENTER=1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Option 1 — Post Daily Transactions runs and reports counts
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. In 「Option (1-8):」 type 「1」.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The daily transaction posting operation runs; on success the status shows 「OK」, the read/selected/posted/updated counts populate, and the message line shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」.
cases.remark: 7000-BUILD-REQUEST WHEN 1 → WS-SUB-PGM 'OUPOST', KO-FUNCTION 'POST'; 2200-LINK-SUB LINK(OUPOST); 7500-SHOW-RESULT (M4). Also min-accepted boundary (Option=1). Mermaid §1.1.

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Option 2 — Post Bill Payment runs with account and amount
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 12345 exists with an open balance.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」.
2. In 「Param:」 type 「12345 1500.75」.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The bill-payment operation posts a payment of 1,500.75 to account 12345; the status shows 「OK」, the posted/updated counts populate and the message line shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」.
cases.remark: WHEN 2 → 'OUPAY'/'PAY '; account→KO-PARM-ACCT, amount→KO-PARM-AMT via 6000-PARSE-PARM. LINK(OUPAY).

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Param is split into account and amount for the operation
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 12345 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」 (Post Bill Payment).
2. In 「Param:」 type 「00000012345 1500.75」 (account, space, amount).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The payment operation is invoked with account = 12345 and amount = 1,500.75; the run succeeds and shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」 with a posted count of 1.
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-PARM UNSTRING by space → 6100-PARSE-ACCT (token1 digits → KO-PARM-ACCT 9(11)), 6200-PARSE-AMT (token2 → KO-PARM-AMT S9(10)V99). Values passed in request area, not shown on MOPSA.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Amount with a single decimal digit is normalized to two decimals
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 12345 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」.
2. In 「Param:」 type 「12345 100.5」.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: The amount is normalized to 100.50 (one fraction digit is scaled up) and the payment posts 100.50 to account 12345; 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」.
cases.remark: 6200-PARSE-AMT: IF WS-NW-FRAC-CNT = 1 → COMPUTE WS-NW-FRAC * 10 (L240-241); KO-PARM-AMT = 100.50.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Amount with more than two decimals is truncated to two
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 12345 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」.
2. In 「Param:」 type 「12345 10.999」.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: Only the first two fraction digits are kept — the amount is 10.99 (the third decimal is ignored) — and the payment posts 10.99 to account 12345.
cases.remark: 6200-PARSE-AMT: fraction accumulated only while WS-NW-FRAC-CNT < 2 (L226-227); extra digits fall to ELSE (integer) after cap — verify 10.99.

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Non-digit characters in Param are ignored during parsing
cases.precondition: F-STD; account 1245 exists.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」.
2. In 「Param:」 type 「12A45 5X0」.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: Letters are skipped: the account is read as 1245 and the amount as 50.00; the payment posts 50.00 to account 1245.
cases.remark: 6100-PARSE-ACCT accumulates only chars '0'..'9'; 6200-PARSE-AMT EVALUATE OTHER → CONTINUE (L236-237).

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Account token longer than 11 digits keeps only the first 11
cases.precondition: F-STD.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」.
2. In 「Param:」 type 「123456789012 25.00」 (12-digit account).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: Only the first 11 characters of the account token are scanned, so the account passed is 12345678901 (the 12th digit is dropped); amount = 25.00.
cases.remark: 6100-PARSE-ACCT PERFORM VARYING WS-NW-POS FROM 1 UNTIL > 11; KO-PARM-ACCT PIC 9(11).

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Successful result populates status, message and all count/amount fields
cases.precondition: F-STD; run Option 「1」 (Post Daily Transactions) with data that yields non-zero counts.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「1」 and press ENTER.
2. Read the whole result block.
cases.data: Result area returns status O, read=100, selected=90, posted=88, updated=88, rejected=2, trans=88, amt1=125000.00, amt2=0.00.
cases.expected: The status field shows 「OK」, the result message shows the operation's status text, and 「Read:」=100, 「Selected:」=90, 「Posted:」=88, 「Updated:」=88, 「Rejected:」=2, 「Trans:」=88, 「Amt1:」=125,000.00, 「Amt2:」=0.00 are all shown; the message line shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」.
cases.remark: 7500-SHOW-RESULT: KO-OK ('O')→'OK'; KO-*-CNT→RC*O; KO-AMT-1/2→RAMT1/2O; column-level output. KOPS copybook.

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Warning result shows WARNING status
cases.precondition: F-STD; run an operation that returns a warning status (e.g. Option 「4」 Assess Fees with some skipped records).
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「4」 and press ENTER.
2. Read the status field.
cases.data: Result area returns status W, with a non-zero skip/reject count. *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The status field shows 「WARNING」, the counts populate (including the rejected/skipped count), and the message line shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」.
cases.remark: 7500-SHOW-RESULT WHEN KO-WARN ('W') → 'WARNING'. Status originates in the linked sub-program.

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Business-error result shows ERROR status but the operation still returns normally
cases.precondition: F-STD; run an operation that links normally but returns an error status (e.g. Option 「2」 payment against a non-existent account).
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「2」, Param 「99999999999 10.00」 (no such account).
2. Press ENTER.
3. Read the status field.
cases.expected: The link succeeds so the message line still shows 「Operation complete. Review the counts below.」, but the status field shows 「ERROR」 and the reject count reflects the failure; nothing is posted.
cases.remark: 7500-SHOW-RESULT EVALUATE OTHER (KO-ERROR 'E') → 'ERROR' (L292-293). Distinct from LINK failure (UT_OPS_ABNORMAL_004). OCOPS behaves correctly → classified Normal.

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Operation cannot be started (target sub-program unavailable)
cases.precondition: F-STD; the target sub-program for the chosen option is disabled/undefined in CICS so its invocation fails. *(needs real data)*
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「1」 (whose sub-program is disabled).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Option = 「1」 with the daily-posting sub-program disabled (invocation returns a not-normal response, e.g. PGMIDERR).
cases.expected: No result counts appear; the screen stays on Admin Batch Operations and the message line shows 「Operation could not be started. Contact support.」.
cases.remark: 2200-LINK-SUB: IF WS-RESP-CD NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) → M3 (ERRMSGO L173) → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY. UI §3 row 3. Runtime fault injection needed.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Option 0 (just below the valid range) is rejected

cases.remark: 7000-BUILD-REQUEST EVALUATE WS-OPTION OTHER → WS-SUB-PGM SPACES → M2. Lower bound (min 1); Option field 9(02).

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Option 9 (just above the valid range) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is displayed.

cases.expected: No operation runs; the message line shows 「Invalid option. Enter 1 through 8.」.

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Option 99 (field maximum) is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD; the initial screen is displayed.
cases.steps:
1. Type Option 「99」 (fills the 2-digit field).
2. Press ENTER.
cases.expected: No operation runs; the message line shows 「Invalid option. Enter 1 through 8.」.
